title: Golden Chickpea Curry Bunny Chow
subtitle: Just heat, combine and eat!
description: When time’s short but you still want to make a meal – and one the whole fam-bam approves of – our amazing pre-prepped, pre-cooked and fast-cook ingredients do the hard yakka for you. All you need to do is a quick heat here, a little assembly there, and boom! Dinner is done, dinner is dusted and dinner is delish.

steps.text: Prep rolls and heat curry: Preheat the oven to 200C, fan-forced. Cut the tops off the rolls. Tear the soft bread in large chunks from inside the bases, leaving 2 thick shells. Put the vegetable curry in a microwave-safe bowl. Heat in the microwave for 3 mins, then stir. Heat for a further 2-3 mins until hot.
Bake bread: Meanwhile, put the roll tops, shells and bread chunks on an oven tray and bake for 5 mins or until lightly toasted.
Prep ingredients: While the bread is baking, pick the coriander sprigs, discarding the tough stems. Combine the mango chutney and 2 tsp water in a large bowl. Add the ranch salad and toss to coat.

Serve up: Using a slotted spoon, fill the shells with the vegetable curry, then divide among plates. Scatter with the coriander and fried shallots and serve with the bread tops, bread chunks and salad. Divide the remaining curry sauce among bowls (use the crunchy roll tops and bread chunks to dunk into the curry). Enjoy!
Did you know?: Bunny chow is a South African fast-food dish consisting of a hollowed-out bread roll or loaf filled with curry.
...: Our range of quick-assembly ingredients helps get dinner on the table quick smart. Now it's time to enjoy your meal.
